data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1183 opened the year with gross claims outstanding of 1,532.1 (USD millions). The syndicate recorded a net release of 41.5 (USD millions) in respect of prior years, largely driven by favourable attritional claims experience across Cargo, Property lineslips and Marine Hull and by a reduction in large losses. Specific large losses cited include disturbances in Hong Kong and Chile, a shipyard crane collapse and an explosion at a refinery plant. A gross movement reconciliation is shown in the technical provisions note, but the explicit quantified prior-year movement is presented on a net (after reinsurance) basis in the movement note and has therefore been used as the primary quantified PYD here.
raw_causal_phrases: The improvement in the net claims ratio of 13.4% was primarily due to better attritional loss experience across a number of classes most notable Cargo, Property Lineslips, and Marine Hull, following remediation work undertaken in 2018.
Large losses decreased by $5.6m, with the largest claims in the current year being the disturbances in Hong Kong and Chile, a shipyard crane collapse and the explosion at a refinery plant.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (gross claims outstanding) - high confidence. The explicit quantified prior year movement is presented in the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note as a NET release of $41.5m; a GROSS prior-year movement figure was not provided in that note. The Technical Provisions reconciliation shows a gross 'movement in the provision' for claims outstanding of (12.7) but this line includes current year movements and therefore was not used as the prior-year development figure per the extraction rules. Because no gross PYD total was given, the report's net PYD ($41.5m) has been used as a last-resort fallback and is flagged accordingly.
